facts.Retrograde Orbit: Only large moon in Solar System orbiting retrograde (156.8° inclination)
facts.Captured KBO: Captured dwarf planet from Kuiper Belt (analogous to Pluto)
facts.Active Cryogeysers: Plumes of gaseous nitrogen and dark dust erupting 8 km high into exosphere
facts.Cantaloupe Terrain: Unique surface texture of dimpled cryogenic terrain
facts.Surface Temperature: 38 K (-235 °C), one of the coldest known bodies in the Solar System
